events.title: Genoa destroys the Pisan fleet at Meloria
events.description: The Genoese navy crushed Pisa's fleet off the islet of Meloria, capturing thousands of prisoners. Pisa never recovered as a sea power, leaving Genoa dominant in the western Mediterranean.
events.html: The Genoese navy crushed Pisa's fleet off the islet of Meloria, capturing thousands of prisoners. Pisa never recovered as a sea power, leaving Genoa dominant in the western Mediterranean.

events.title: Francis II dissolves the Holy Roman Empire
events.description: Under pressure from Napoleon, Francis II laid down the imperial crown and dissolved the Holy Roman Empire. A political order dating back to Charlemagne's coronation in 800 came to an end.
events.html: Under pressure from Napoleon, Francis II laid down the imperial crown and dissolved the Holy Roman Empire. A political order dating back to Charlemagne's coronation in 800 came to an end.

events.title: Bolivia declares independence
events.description: An assembly in Chuquisaca proclaimed the independence of Upper Peru, naming the new republic after Simón Bolívar. Antonio José de Sucre became its first president.
events.html: An assembly in Chuquisaca proclaimed the independence of Upper Peru, naming the new republic after Simón Bolívar. Antonio José de Sucre became its first president.

events.title: William Kemmler is the first person executed by electric chair
events.description: Convicted murderer William Kemmler was executed at Auburn Prison, New York. The botched execution took two shocks, and came amid the 'war of the currents' between Edison and Westinghouse.
events.html: Convicted murderer William Kemmler was executed at Auburn Prison, New York. The botched execution took two shocks, and came amid the 'war of the currents' between Edison and Westinghouse.

events.title: US bomber drops the atomic bomb on Hiroshima
events.description: The B-29 Enola Gay dropped a uranium bomb on Hiroshima, the first nuclear weapon used in war. Some 70,000 people died at once and perhaps 140,000 by the end of 1945.
events.html: The B-29 Enola Gay dropped a uranium bomb on Hiroshima, the first nuclear weapon used in war. Some 70,000 people died at once and perhaps 140,000 by the end of 1945.

events.title: Tim Berners-Lee makes the World Wide Web public
events.description: Tim Berners-Lee posted a summary of his World Wide Web project to an internet newsgroup, inviting outside collaboration. The web, created at CERN, spread rapidly and transformed communication.
